basic_profile.bio: I’m a 35-year-old residing in Portland, Oregon. I work as a freelance graphic designer with a passion for historical romance novels and vintage motorcycles. When I'm not working, I'm often found exploring new cafes around the city, indulging in a good book, or going on long rides on my Moto Guzzi. I’m currently single and enjoy the flexibility and freedom that comes with it. My online hours are usually late evenings and weekends, as I'm often busy with client work during the day.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Fine Arts, which I pursued out of a lifelong love for creativity and design. Over the years, I've honed my skills through various freelance projects and online courses. My interest in vintage culture and historical literature has led me to explore and learn extensively about different eras, which I often share in the form of detailed posts or discussions.
